calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.region,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND ds.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY ds.region
ORDER BY net_sales DESC;

SELECT MAX(sale_date) as latest_sales_date, MIN(sale_date) as earliest_sales_date
FROM fact_sales_line;

SELECT DISTINCT dd.fiscal_year
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_year;

SELECT MAX(fsl.sale_date) as latest_sales_date_fy2025, MIN(fsl.sale_date) as earliest_sales_date_fy2025
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST';

SELECT 
  ds.region,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 2) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fsl.net_amount) DESC) as rank
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND ds.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY ds.region
ORDER BY net_sales DESC;
